label: Ordinary Hadwiger conjecture
statement_summary: For every finite simple graph G and integer t>=1, chi(G)>=t implies a K_t minor.
scope: All finite simple graphs; every integer t; no size, density, independence, parity or graph-class restriction.
relation_to_hadwiger: The full project objective.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Clique-minor model formulation
statement_summary: A K_t minor is witnessed by t nonempty pairwise disjoint connected vertex sets, each pair joined by an edge.
scope: Finite graphs; all branch sets and all pair adjacencies must hold simultaneously.
relation_to_hadwiger: Exact witness language for the full conclusion.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Classical small cases
statement_summary: Ordinary Hadwiger is established for t<=4.
scope: Minor-order indexing t, not the alternative color-bound indexing s=t-1.
relation_to_hadwiger: Established cases; not a general induction template.
checked_locator: SRC-0003 §1, attribution to Hadwiger and Dirac
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: Original Hadwiger/Dirac papers not directly checked; inherited claim recorded from a checked primary later paper.

label: The t=5 equivalence
statement_summary: K_5-minor-free graphs are 4-colorable, equivalent to the Four Color Theorem.
scope: All finite loopless graphs; Wagner reduction plus Four Color Theorem.
relation_to_hadwiger: First difficult established case.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: The t=6 case
statement_summary: Every K_6-minor-free graph is 5-colorable; this case is equivalent to the Four Color Theorem.
scope: All finite loopless graphs; uses the Four Color Theorem.
relation_to_hadwiger: Largest fully settled minor order in checked contemporary literature.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Apex reduction for t=6
statement_summary: Every minor-minimal K_6-minor-free graph that is not 5-colorable is apex.
scope: Hypothetical Hadwiger graph as defined in SRC-0003 §1; no analogous unrestricted t theorem is supplied.
relation_to_hadwiger: A genuine global bridge within this exact fixed-t case.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Line graphs
statement_summary: h(G)>=chi(G) for line graphs of finite loopless multigraphs.
scope: Line-graph class, including parallel edges in the underlying multigraph.
relation_to_hadwiger: A class theorem; no coverage theorem for arbitrary graphs.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Density and degeneracy order
statement_summary: K_t-minor-free graphs have degeneracy O(t sqrt(log t)); this order is tight for degeneracy.
scope: Uniform asymptotic statement; constants not sharp-coloring constants; degree and density normalization must be distinguished.
relation_to_hadwiger: Density supplies a weaker coloring bound and shows why pure degeneracy cannot reach a universal O(t) degeneracy bound.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: Kostochka original not directly checked; tightness read in checked primary later paper.

label: First improvement beyond degeneracy
statement_summary: For every beta>1/4, K_t-minor-free graphs are O_beta(t (log t)^beta)-colorable.
scope: Constant may depend on beta; no beta=1/4 claim.
relation_to_hadwiger: Historical uniform improvement, superseded in order by RES-0010.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Directly checked general coloring bound
statement_summary: K_t-minor-free graphs are O(t log log t)-colorable.
scope: All finite simple graphs; asymptotic large-t notation; not a current-record assertion while OPEN-0008 persists.
relation_to_hadwiger: Verified uniform bound, still weaker than linear and sharp Hadwiger.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Small-subgraph control theorem
statement_summary: There is absolute C>=1 with chi(G)<=Ct(1+f_C(G,t)) when G is K_t-minor-free.
scope: Integer t>=3; f_C is the maximum chi(H)/a over integer t>=a>=t/sqrt(log t), H a K_a-minor-free subgraph of G, |V(H)|<=Ca log^4 a.
relation_to_hadwiger: A real transfer theorem; its conclusion retains multiplicative constants.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Linear Hadwiger reduces to small graphs
statement_summary: For a suitable absolute C, a Ct coloring bound for every K_t-minor-free H with |V(H)|<=Ct log^4 t implies a C^2t bound for every K_t-minor-free graph.
scope: All integer t>=3; same C as in the corollary; small-graph hypothesis is a parameterized infinite family, not a fixed finite enumeration.
relation_to_hadwiger: Closes the size-transfer step for the linear weakening; does not yield t-1 colors.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Linear bound in clique-restricted classes
statement_summary: For each fixed r>=3 there is C_r such that every K_r-subgraph-free K_t-minor-free graph is C_rt-colorable.
scope: C_r may depend on r; all integer t>=1. Subgraph-free K_r differs from minor-free K_r.
relation_to_hadwiger: Special-class linear result; does not exhaust arbitrary graphs.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Small highly connected subgraph
statement_summary: There is absolute C>=1: density d(G)>=Ck, k>=t, and no K_t minor imply a nonempty k-connected H with |V(H)|<=C^2t log^3 t.
scope: Integers t>=3 and k>=t; d(G)=|E(G)|/|V(G)|, half average degree.
relation_to_hadwiger: A connectivity extraction tool, not preservation of exact chromatic number.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Reported September 2026 improvement
statement_summary: A discovery lead reports O(t sqrt(log log t)) colors for K_t-minor-free graphs.
scope: Manuscript statement, hypotheses, proof and version not directly retrieved.
relation_to_hadwiger: Freshness lead only; never consume as a verified theorem or latest established bound.
checked_locator: Direct retrieval failed; SEARCH_LOG.md documents attempts.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: Search snippets are insufficient evidence. NOT PROMOTED.

label: Odd strengthening counterexample
statement_summary: For every delta>0 and all sufficiently large t, a graph with chi(G)>=(3/2-delta)t exists with no odd K_t minor.
scope: Threshold depends on delta; ordinary minors and odd minors differ.
relation_to_hadwiger: Disproves the odd strengthening; does not disprove ordinary Hadwiger.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: Checked preprint theorem, not independently verified proof; publication status retained.

label: Odd alpha<=2 asymptotic obstruction
statement_summary: For every eta>0 and large enough n, an n-vertex graph with alpha(G)<=2 exists without any odd K_t minor of order t>=(1/3+eta)n.
scope: Threshold depends on eta; odd minors only.
relation_to_hadwiger: Blocks parity-strengthened half-order targets.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Ordinary-to-odd bound transfer
statement_summary: If every K_t-minor-free graph is f(t)-colorable, every odd-K_t-minor-free graph is 2f(t)-colorable.
scope: For each integer t and integer coloring bound f(t); factor 2 retained.
relation_to_hadwiger: Order-of-growth transfer, not sharp equivalence.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Fractional factor-two bound
statement_summary: K_t-minor-free graphs have fractional chromatic number at most 2(t-1).
scope: Integer t>=2; fractional coloring, not integral proper coloring.
relation_to_hadwiger: A linear fractional relaxation; no automatic rounding to t-1 colors.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Weighted stable-set theorem
statement_summary: For every nonnegative rational weight function on a K_t-minor-free graph, some stable set has at least 1/(2(t-1)) of total weight.
scope: Integer t>=2; rational nonnegative weights as stated in the paper.
relation_to_hadwiger: LP-dual formulation of the fractional bound.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
equivalent_formulations: Weighted rational stable-set statement and fractional factor-two coloring bound via LP duality.

label: Duchet–Meyniel bound
statement_summary: (2alpha(G)-1)h(G)>=|V(G)| for nonempty finite graphs.
scope: Uses independence number, not chromatic number; alpha=2 gives h(G)>=ceil(n/3).
relation_to_hadwiger: Necessary-consequence weakening of ordinary Hadwiger.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: Original not directly checked; authoritative survey statement verified.

label: Almost-everywhere Hadwiger
statement_summary: Ordinary Hadwiger holds with probability tending to 1 in the uniform labeled G(n,1/2) model.
scope: As n tends to infinity; no guarantee for every graph or fixed finite census.
relation_to_hadwiger: Probabilistic special-model result, not universal coverage.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Hajós strengthening is false
statement_summary: Forcing a clique subdivision of order chi(G) is a false strengthening of ordinary Hadwiger.
scope: Subdivisions are stricter than minors; general assertion false, no new threshold claim recorded.
relation_to_hadwiger: Reject topological-minor substitution for the ordinary target.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: Original counterexample papers not directly checked; historical status retained from survey.

label: List counterexample family
statement_summary: For every integer k>=1, a K_(3k+2)-minor-free graph exists that is not 4k-choosable.
scope: List coloring; source parameter renamed k to avoid collision with excluded minor order t.
relation_to_hadwiger: Even the relaxed list analogue with t colors is false in general.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Planar list barrier
statement_summary: Some planar graphs are not 4-choosable.
scope: List assignments, not ordinary planar coloring.
relation_to_hadwiger: Shows sharp ordinary Hadwiger cannot be replaced by a sharp list-coloring assertion.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Four Color Theorem
statement_summary: Every finite loopless planar graph is 4-colorable.
scope: Computer-assisted proof combines reducibility computation and global unavoidability; this session reran neither.
relation_to_hadwiger: Imported dependency for t=5 and t=6.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: 633 configurations in SRC-0004 are an unavoidable/reducible family, not an enumeration of all planar graphs.

label: Formal Four Color Theorem proof
statement_summary: Gonthier reports a complete Coq-checked formalization of the Four Color Theorem.
scope: Precisely the formal graph/map formulation in report §2; does not formalize general Hadwiger.
relation_to_hadwiger: Formalization precedent; no proof assistant result for this project.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: Formal proof scripts not rerun in RL2.

label: Contraction-critical reduction
statement_summary: To establish Hadwiger it suffices to exclude the corresponding contraction-critical counterexamples.
scope: Fix t first; choose a minor-minimal counterexample. Every proper minor is (t-1)-colorable. Chromatic number is not generally minor-monotone.
relation_to_hadwiger: A legitimate global reduction; extra class hypotheses still need proof.
checked_locator: SRC-0016 §2; SRC-0003 definition of Hadwiger graph
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Bounded-degree triangle-free coloring
statement_summary: For every epsilon>0 there is K: triangle-free K_t-minor-free G with Delta(G)<=exp(t^(1-epsilon)) has chi(G)<=Kt/sqrt(log t).
scope: Large-t asymptotic interpretation; K depends on epsilon; cannot omit the maximum-degree condition.
relation_to_hadwiger: Restricted-class preprint result.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.

label: Structural dichotomy for counterexamples
statement_summary: Every counterexample at parameter t has either a K_(a,b) subgraph, a=(log t)^(1/2-o(1)), b=exp(t^(1-o(1))), or a <=t-vertex subgraph with >=t^(2-o(1)) edges in one neighborhood.
scope: Asymptotic structural statement from preprint; an OR of two alternatives, neither ruled out by this theorem.
relation_to_hadwiger: Global necessary-condition theorem; not a contradiction or complete minor construction.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
caveats: Do not infer either alternative alone is unavoidable or impossible.

label: H-Hadwiger family
statement_summary: For a fixed t-vertex H, the assertion 'no H minor implies (t-1)-colorable' is implied by ordinary Hadwiger at t.
scope: Finite H; the family over all H includes H=K_t and hence includes the original conjecture.
relation_to_hadwiger: A collection of weaker target-minor instances, not an independent full-conjecture solution.
verification_meaning: Statement and hypotheses checked where indicated; no independent reconstruction or formal proof rerun.
